name: Voxel Table Registry
definition: A central voxel registry providing O(1) lookup by ID and name. It manages voxel definitions, supporting loading from a ScriptableObject database or falling back to hardcoded definitions. ID 0 is reserved for air/null.
summary: The Voxel Table Registry is a centralized lookup structure providing constant-time access to voxel definitions, differing from hash-grid methods by focusing on semantic definition management rather than spatial coordinate mapping.
